tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// smin dbang zab mo'i mtshams sbyor rigs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ngo mtshar bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

rat+na gling pa'i gter byon thugs rje chen po gsang 'dus dbang gi bshad pa skal ldan yid kyi gdung sel rna ba'i bdud rtsi bzhugs so// 'di'i gsham du phan yon brjod pa yang yod/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ma gyur 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che bde blag tu thob par bya snyam pa'i byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed legs par gsal btab nas gsan par mdzad 'tshal/ de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'gro 'dul thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgo nas gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams yang dag pa'i lam la dkri ba'i thabs tshul du ma las skabs su bab pa sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i skye bdun myong grol ril bu sgrub pa la brten nas smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo bgyid pa yin cing*/ thog mar yid ches dang ba 'dren pa'i phyir du lo rgyus zur tsam smos na/ de yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug ni dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa thams cad kyi thugs rje gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang gzugs rgya mtsho chen po lta bu ste/ chos kyi sku 'khor 'das thams cad la ye gdod ma nas khyab pa'i rang bzhin du nges shing*/ des na kun khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba zhes bya ba bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig pa'i ngang du lhun gyis grub par gnas so// rgyud chen las/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams// thugs rje chen por ma gyur med// de nyid sku gsung thugs bcas pa// gsang 'dus rgyud 'dir ma 'dus med// ces gsungs pa dang*/ mdo sde za ma tog las/ nam mkha' ni kun tu khyab pa thugs rje chen po'i zhal dang*/ rlung gi 'gro 'ong ni grag stong gsung gi rang bzhin/ nyi ma dang zla ba rab tu gsal ba ye shes spyan gyi rnam pa ste zhes gsungs pa de la sogs pa brda dang brda'i sgo nas gcig dang du ma'i rnam par rol pa 'gro ba'i don du bstan pa dang*/

rgyal ba rnams kyi gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor sgyur ba'i longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku'i bkod pa'i dbang du byas na/ de yang 'og min stug po bkod pa zhes gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i zhing khams rgya khyon tshad las 'das pa bkod pa dang yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing de'i ston pa rnam par snang mdzad spyan ras gzigs gangs can mtsho zhes bya ba/ gnas nges pa 'og min gyi zhing der/ 'khor nges pa sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpas bskor zhing*/ dus nges pa 'khor ba ji srid kyi bar du/ chos nges pa theg chen gsang sngags 'ba' zhig 'chad pa/ gtso mchog nges pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste/ de'i ba spu'i khung bu re rer yang 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa sprul pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rang gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mtha' yas par mdzad pa dang*/ phyag gi lhung bzed kyi nang spos chu'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su me tog pad+ma nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar skyes pa'i ze'u 'bru re re'i nang na'ang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med par sprul pa'i/ me tog bcu gsum pa'i ze'u 'bru dbus ma gcig gi nang du stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di chags shing*/ de yang thugs ka'i thad du gnas pa'i rten 'brel gyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir dge sdig gang byas stobs dang 'gyur gzhan las che bar gsungs pa'i bsod nams mchog gi 'du byas pa thar pa'i lam stegs kyi gzhi kho nar grub pa dang*/ nges pa'i don du thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin dang*/ drang ba'i don du 'gro ba'i don la slar yang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i tshul dang*/ lam la slob pa sogs snang tshul du mar bstan pa dang*/ ma 'ongs par sangs rgyas 'od zer dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal por mngon par 'tshang rgya ba sogs dus gsum dang dus med kyi sems can rnams 'dul ba'i ched du/

de lta bu'i mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs par dbang bsgyur ba'i 'phags chen byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che spyad cing*/ stong nyid shes rab bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin chos thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin ma/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba rnams bskyed pa'i gzhi gsang ba ye shes dang dbyer med zung du 'jug pa'i rang rtsal snang ba'i rnam par rol pa sras nor bu 'dzin pa dang sras mo gsang sngags 'dzin ma/ de las ma g.yos par rgyal ba rigs kyi yab lnga dang*/ yum lnga/ sems dpa' yab yum bcu drug /bskal bzang zhing gi 'dren pa sangs rgyas stong dang rtsa gnyis/ 'gro 'dul sprul sku thub drug /sgo skyong khro rgyal yab yum sogs mdor na zhi ba dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rab 'byams mtha' yas pa bsam mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin can rnams kyang 'di nyid kyi rol gar las ma 'das shing*/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal pos bstan pa'i dam chos pad+ma dkar po dang*/ snang ba rol pa/ za ma tog che chung la sogs mdo sde mang po dang*/ bya rgyud pad+ma drwa ba dang don yod zhags pa sogs dang*/ spyod rgyud la snying rje chen po rang bzhin rgyud sogs dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud la pad+ma cod pan gyi skor rnams dang*/ bla med la pad+ma rgyal po'i rgyud la sogs pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgos rgyud dpag tu med pa rnams rgya gar gyi yul ljongs tha grur spel zhing thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis khyab par mdzad cing*/ bod yul 'dir ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni bcom ldan 'das kyis mdzad pa tha ma'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ spyan ras gzigs kyis bod kha ba can du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba na/ 'phags pa khyod kyi gdul ba'i zhing kho nar nges pas de ltar yid dam 'cha' bar gyis shig ces gsungs pas/ 'phags pa nyid kyi po ṭa la'i ri bo nas byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs su dgongs pa gtad tsam na/

sa 'og tu grang dmyal mi bzad pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor bas nyen pa dpag tu med pa rnams snying rje'i lcags kyus nye bar drangs nas thar pa'i lam la bkod/ de nas 'phags pa mchog dang*/ rje btsun sgrol mas sprul sgyur gyi sgo nas chos kyi snod dang rten du rung ba'i phyir thabs mkhas thugs rje'i 'phrul kyis bho ṭa zhes pa'i rkang gnyis pa rnams spel zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po'i rnam 'phrul rgyal po'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po 'khrungs pa des rgyal khrims la brten nas mi chos kyi srol tshugs/ de nas byang sems kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa tho tho ri snyan shal gyi skabs/ pho brang gi yang rtser mdo za ma tog /dpang kong phyag rgya pa/ shel gyi mchod rten rnams nam mkha' nas babs te dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas spyan ras gzigs dngos srong btsan sgam po zhes grags pa dbu gtsug tu rigs bdag snang mtha' 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa des chos 'khor lha sa'i gtsug lag khang sogs bzhengs pa dang jo shāka rnam gnyis spyan drangs/ gzhan yang sems can rnams gsung yi ge drug pa'i sgo nas 'gro don phrin las rgya cher spel ba sogs lha chos kyi srol gtod/ de nas 'jam dpal sprul pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis thugs bskyed rmad du byung ba'i sgo nas/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas/ za hor gyi mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ bi ma la mi tra/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi paṇa grub mang po spyan drangs/ bod yul gyi lha srin mi bsrun pa rnams btul zhing dam la bzhag nas bka'i srung mar bskos pa dang/ zan yang dpal gyi bsam yas gtsos gtsug lag khang chen po brgya dang rtsa brgyad/ phran bu stong dang rtsa gnyis bzhengs par mdzad/ lo tsā ba bai ro tsa na/ ka cog rnam gnyis/ ldan ma rtse mang sogs skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyis mdo sngags kyi chos tshul du ma bsgyur zhing gtan la phab/

khyad par gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud mkha' 'gro'i brda' yig las o rgyan chen pos sgra rang 'gyur gnang*/ bka'i bsdu ba po ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ lang gro lo tsā ba gsum gyis shog ser la dag par bkod/ ar+ya pā lo'i gling dang*/ lho brag gnam skas can rnams su gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes nas las can rnams rgyud smin par mdzad de/ smon lam zab mos mtshams sbyar te/ bka'i srung ma rnams la gnyer du gtad cing bse yi sgrom bur bcug nas zab gter du sbas pa ste/ them byang las/ thugs rje chen po gsang 'dus zhi khro'i skor: mon mkhar steng du mkha' ris gdan drangs tshe: mtsho rgyal bdag dang btsun pa mchog dbyangs dang : shel dkar bza' dang lang gro lo tsā dang : a tsar ye shes rnams kyis yi ger bris: gnam skas brag la gter kha gsum sbas te: zhes dang*/ khyad par sngon 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyis 'gro ba'i don du thabs la ma rmongs pa'i tshul du ma'i sprul sgyur gyis bram ze'i rigs dang*/ gzhan yang gang zag mchog gi skye ba bdun brtsegs can kho nar bzhes pa'i sku sha rnams dang*/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi bdud rtsi chos sman dam rdzas la sogs pa gter gnas gzhan rnams la'ang rim par sbas shing*/ gter kha 'dir yang shog ser dang skye bdun dam rdzas sogs rgya rim pa bdun gyis btab nas/ dge bsnyen sku lha mkha' ri dang : klu bdud nag po mgo dgu dang : ma mo sngags kyi srung ma dang : dam can rdo rje legs pa la: bka' 'di gtad do sa ma yaḥ ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: las can thugs rje chen po yi: skal ldan gcig dang 'phrad par shog: ces smon lam mdzad pa bzhin phyis dus la bab pa na lang gro lo tsā'i skye ba 'gro 'dul gling pa'am/ zhig po gling pa'am/ rat+na gling pa zhes yongs su grags pa de ltar gling pa gsum gyi mtshan dang ldan pa/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug de nyid kyis zab gter zhal phye ba'i skabs/

gter srung dge bsnyen mkha' ri lcam dral yang khrom tshogs rnams kyis dngos su mthong bar gter sgo bstan pa dang*/ me tog gi char 'babs shing*/ dri bzang gi ngad ldang ba/ dbang po'i gzhu lta bu kha dog lnga ldan gyi 'ja'i gur khang dang*/ dar yugs brkyang pa lta bu sogs ya mtshan rmad du byung ba'i ltas du ma bcas shog ser dang dam rdzas sogs spyan drangs shing*/ spyir o rgyan chen pos gter kha gzhan rnams kyi chos bdag gi gtso bo yang rgyal dbang karma pa na rim lung gis zin bzhin dang*/ sgos su chos 'di'i bka' babs kyi mnga' bdag rje bdun pa chos grags rgya mtsho la gter byon gyi zab chos tshang ma dang*/ dam rdzas a ma sogs 'bul zhing*/ gzhan yang rje 'brug pa rgyal dbang chos rje sogs bka' babs chos kyi bdag po lnga/ nye ba'i thugs sras rnam bzhi/ rigs ldan lnga dang dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa brgyad/ las can chos bdag nyer lnga la sogs pa byon dang 'byon 'gyur gyi bu slob nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam gyis gzhan don phrin las kyi sgo du mas sa chen po'i rdul dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bkod pa sogs phan pa'i yon tan rang re so skye'i blo las 'das shing brjod par dka' na'ang cha shas tsam zhig smos na/ don tig 'gro ba kun grol gyi rgyud las/ thugs rje'i phrin las shugs 'byung ba: 'di nyid myong ba tsam gyis ni: blo dang bral ba'i don rtogs nas: bsgom mi dgos pa myong grol lo: zhes dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ ma sgrub sangs rgyas thob thabs lnga: sngon sbyang las dang thos grol dang : rang byung rgyud mchog btags grol dang : mtshan ldan pad can rtsa yi gnad: gsang lam zab mo'i 'pho ba dang : ngo mtshar mchog rdzas skye bdun no: zhes pa ltar gter chen nyid nas kyang 'phan yul du chos rje smon lam rgyal pos bskul ba'i bum sgrub dang*/ gzhan yang sgrub chen sum cu lhag tsam mdzad pas/

gzhung du gsal ba'i phyi nang gi rtags mtshan khyad par can rnams dang*/ thun pa rnams kyis kyang thugs rje chen po zhal mjal ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gnas du ma byung zhing*/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skye 'gro grangs med pa rnams 'khor ba mtha' can chos nyid mngon gyur gyi gnas la bkod pa'i phrin las rgya chen rgyun mi chad par spel zhing*/ rgyal sras tshe dbang grags pa zhes dbang chen rta mgrin dngos su sprul pa'i grub pa yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba de nyid dgung lo brgya dang bcur bzhugs shing*/ zab chos kyi rgyal thabs chen por gyur pa de las rim par brgyud ba'i rngod shākya bkra shis/ mkhor drung pa bsod nams bkra shis/ tshe chog pa pad+ma dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin pa bkra shis dbang phyug /yongs 'dzin karma don yod/ drin chen karma chags med/ che tshang pa gsung rab rgya mtsho/ 'jam mgon bstan pa'i nyin byed/ rig 'dzin thugs kyi rdo rje sogs mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las thob pa'i smin byed dbang bskur zab mo bgyid pa la/ de yang thugs rje kun la khyab pa snying rje'i spyan ras kyis 'gro la dus drug gzigs pa'i mkha' dbyings yangs por rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin grub thob rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi sprin phung gtibs shing*/ yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gros dngos grub rnam pa gnyis kyi char rgyun ni 'bebs/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas kyi mdangs 'ja' tshon ltar bkra zhing gsal/ dam can srung ma dgyes pa'i gad rgyangs chen po'i dbyar rnga ni ldir/ sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dpon slob rnams kyang dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bskyed rdzogs zung du 'jug pa'i sa ma dhi dang ma bral bar sgrub pa chen po'i sbyor dngos rjes gsum gzhung dang mthun par grub cing*/ des na lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ mdor na o rgyan ngas bstan chos rnams la:

gzhung bzhin su dang su yis spyad pa kun: thams cad nga sprul yin par shes par bya: phyi rabs kun gyis yid gnyis the tshom spang: gus pas bkur sti phu dud 'brel ba thob: ces gsungs pa dang*/ dbang bskur 'di nyid thob pa'i phan yon ni/ gsang 'dus rgyud kyi dbang gi le'u las/ dus gsum bder gshegs sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las ma lus pa: yig bdun dag la yang dag rdzogs: dbang thob yon tan mtha' yas te: zhes sogs dang*/ yig bdun dbang dang lung thob mi'i: las dang las kyi rnam smin rung: mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga: dus 'di nyid la byang bar 'gyur: zhes so// de dag la sogs pa bka' gter gyi gzhung rnams su du mar gsungs shing*/ sngags rnying ma'i lugs 'dir ring brgyud bka' ma dang*/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang brgyud pa ste bka' srol de gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i smin cing grol ba'i dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i phyir khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i maṇ+ḍal zhig gnang 'tshal/ zhes pa'ang rgyal dbang mchog gi spyan ras ut+pal gyi 'babs stegs su/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub chen dbang dang 'brel ba'i phan yon brjod pa bzhugs so//

na mo lo kī shwa ra ya/ 'o na da lam skabs su babs pa skye bdun dam rdzas kyi bum sgrub chen mo'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus pa tsam zhu na/ de la spyir rgyud sde bzhi ka nas ril bu la brten nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i thabs dpag tu med pa gsungs te/ 'jam dpal dmar po'i sgo nas shes rab ril bu dang*/ dbyangs can ma'i shes rab ril bu sogs bsgrub pa la brten nas shes rab dang blo gros skyed thabs gsungs pa dang*/ gsar ma'i bde dgyes gsang gsum/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum sogs bla med kyi rgyud sde thams cad dang*/ rnying ma'i bka' dgongs phur gsum sogs rgyud sde thams cad nas kyang*/ bza' ba'i dam tshig gi skabs bdud rtsi ril bu bya thabs/ de'i phan yon myong ba tsam gyis mchog gi dngos grub thob tshul mtha' yas par gsungs shing*/ ma ṇi ril bu 'di la'ang gter kha du ma nas byon pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu dang*/ gter ston du mas bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu dang*/ mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud rim byon dang*/ dpal ldan sa skya na rim gyis bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ 'bri gung ba'i bdud rtsi ril bu sogs kyang 'dres shing don la mchog gi dam rdzas ril bu yin pa'i phyir dang*/ bdud rtsi ril bu yang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga yin la/ 'di mchog gi skye bdun gtso bor byas pa'i ril bu yin pas/ rgyud sde rnams nas bdud rtsi ril bu'i phan yon ji skad bshad pa thams cad ma ṇi ril bu 'di la 'byung ngo*// khyad par gsar ma'i bde mchog rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud chen po rnams nas kyang skye ba bdun pa yin min brtag pa'i thabs dang*/ skye bdun de yi sha la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs rgya chen po gsungs shing*/ rnying ma'i thugs rje khros ma'i chos skor la yang gsungs so// khyad par du gsang sngags rnying ma bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud sde rnams nas gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i gdams ngag ma bsgom par sangs rgyas pa'i thabs bzhi gsungs te/

btags pas grol ba btags grol 'khor lo/ thos pas grol ba thos grol dang 'pho ba/ rig pas grol pa ḍā ki mtshan ldan pad+ma can/ zos pas grol ba skye bdun ril bu dang bzhi'o// de la thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ de nas skye bdun sha bsgrub pa: de nyid brtags bsgrub 'gro don bya: brtag pa skye bdun gang yin des: mi yi skye ba bdun sogs dran: de yang chos ldan skye bdun pa'i: ro blangs sha rnams legs bskams te: zhes dang*/ thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ dal 'byor chos ldan mi lus ni: bdun ni brtsegs mar blangs pa yi: nges par yid ches ldan pa de'i: ro blangs sha rnams legs par bskam: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sprul pa'i gter chen dri med lhun po dang*/ gzhan yang gter kha bcu gsum nas byon pa'i bram ze skye bdun gyi sha dang*/ bram ze dung rna can gyi sku sha pad+ma gling pa'i gter ma dang*/ rat+na gling pas pañtsa lha khang nas bton pa'i bram ze lo li jo sa'i sku sha dang*/ gnam skas can nas bton pa'i bram ze dz+we ta ri pa'i sku sha dang*/ bram ze dri med snying pos gtsos bram ze nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sku sha rnams gtso bo byas nas gsar rnying ris med kyi dam rdzas zab mo mtha' dag kun 'dus kyi ril bu ste/ de ltar yid ches khungs btsun dang ba 'dren pa'i gnas kyi rang bzhin la/ de'ang*/ skye bdun bsgrub pa'i phan yon dang*/ ril bu zos pa'i phan yon/ dbang thob pa'i phan yon dang gsum mo// dang po bsgrub pa'i phan yon ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ rgyal ba mnyes mchod rgyun mi chad: sems can sgrib sbyong rgyun mi chad: bdag la dngos grub rgyun mi chad: rgyun chad med pa gsum ldan gyi: ting 'dzin 'di zab 'jig rten 'dir: ma byung mi 'byung 'byung mi 'gyur: dngos grub ma lus kun 'byung zhing : myur du 'grub par the tshom med:

sgrub thabs gsum po bsgrub lam sbyangs: don gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas so: zhes dang*/ gsang sgrub las/ spyan ras gzigs dang gnyis med de: bar do'i 'jigs pa kun bral te: gsang ba 'dus dang gnyis med 'gyur: zhes dang*/ sgrub pa byed pa'i rnal 'byor rnams: tshe 'dir rig 'dzin thob par 'gyur: dang du longs shig skal ldan rnams// zhes dang*/ sgrub chen las/ snyigs ma'i dus su thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa dar bar 'byung ste: kun kyang ma ṇi dung phyur la sogs dar ba'i tshe: rang bzhin du bzlas pas sgrub chen 'di nyid brgya 'gyur gyi yon tan che'o: zhes o rgyan nga yi bka'o: zhes pas sgrub chen 'di la bye chung gcig thon na dung phyur gcig 'ong nges so/ spyir yig drug gi phan yon mtha' yas pa mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs shing*/ de yang phyi yig drug /nang yig bcu/ gsang ba yig bdun yin par gsungs pas/ yi ge bdun pa 'di yi phan yon ni/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ 'jig rten sems can srog bton pa'i: bsod nams 'phags pas bgrang bar nus: yig bdun lan gcig brjod pa yi: yon tan brjod par ga la nus: khams gsum sems can ma lus kun: sangs rgyas sar bkod yon tan rnams: bgrang bar nus kyi yig bdun pa: gcig brjod yon tan brjod mi nus: rgyal ba nam mkha' gang ba laḥ mchod pa phul ba'i bsod nams tshogs: bgrang bar nus kyi yig bdun pa: gcig brjod yon tan brjod mi nus: yang snying yid la sus byed tshad: thugs rje chen po nyid yin phyir: bar chad bgegs zhi 'gro ba 'dul: snang srid 'khor 'das dbang du 'gyur: yang snying thos tshad dran reg rung: sgom bzlas 'dri 'chang bton pa rnams: yon tan ldan zhing gar skyes kyang: spyan ras gzigs dang bral mi srid: ces sogs gsungs pa dang*/ gnyis pa ril bu zos pa'i phan yon ni/ thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/

de nas bcom ldan rigs bdag la: 'dus pa'i 'khor gyis yongs zhus pa: rtsol med ngo mtshar mchog gi rdzas: zos pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs: bdag cag 'khor la bka' stsol cig: bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba: ngo mtshar de nyid bsgrub pa na: byang chub sems ldan rnal 'byor gyis: 'gro don 'khor ba dong sprugs thabs: zhes pa nas/ ril bu su yi ltor song ba: tshe rabs gang dang gar skyes kyang: spyan ras gzigs dang 'bral mi srid: bdag pas gzhan gces 'gro don spyod: yig bdun bzlas shing dam tshig bsrungs: thams cad 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: ces pa'i bar gsungs pa dang*/ 'di dag gi sgrub pa'i phan yon rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i gter lung las/ gsang 'dus rgyud don skye bdun sgrub pa'i thabs: ma 'ongs don du o rgyan pad+ma ngas: chos dang dam rdzas gnam skas brag la sbas: ma 'ongs srin mo khros 'dra'i brag de nas: gter ston 'gro 'dul rdo rjes bton pa las: phan yon gnas skabs mthar thug gnyis su bshad: gnas skabs 'jigs pa brgyad grol mthar thug ni: 'gro ba'i don du sprul ba 'byon pa'o: sgrub gnas spa gro stag tshang sbas pa yi: 'dzad med rig 'dzin dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gter: ril bu āḥyig rang byon kha dog gsum du yod: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bcu kha ral dusaḥ pad+ma rdo rje'i ming can de la sprod: gza' dang rdor legs dam tshig gnyer du bskos: ces dang*/ pad+ma bka' yi thang yig las/ rgyal sras lha rje'i sku sha gter du sbas skabs su/ dbang po lnga dang zag chu sha dang rus: shig gi snying tsam su yi ltor song ba: rmongs pa'i ltor song mi yi dngos grub 'byung: dbul po'i ltor song nor gyi dngos grub thob: 'chi 'pho'i ltor song tshe yi dngos grub thob: dad can ltor song chos kyi dngos grub thob: de la sogs kyi yon tan mang yod kyang: log lta can gyis yon tan skyon du mthong :

de yang 'brel ba sna gcig thob pa yin: sgrib pa dag ste chos nyid las sad 'gyur: ces gsungs pa dang*/ skye bdun ril bus 'dul ba'i dus tshod ni deng gi skabs nyid du nges pa ste/ don tig 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi rgyud las/ snyigs ma'i dus su tshe thung nad mang zhing*// longs spyod dbul phongs nyon mongs rang sar grol// chos la nyan bsam sgom gsum gus mkhan med// de dus tshegs chung don che'i dam rdzas 'di// 'gro don phyogs bcur skyo ngal med par spel// zhes pa la sogs pa'i phan yon brjod las 'das par mchis so// ril bu 'di nyid ri bo chen po'i rtser sbas na/ ri de la rlung phog tshad kyi skye 'gro pho mo dang*/ snang srid kyi mi ma yin pa thams cad thar pa'i lam la 'god par 'gyur ro// lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnod 'tshe thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// tshong 'dus dang sa mdo rnams su sbas na der phyin tshad thams cad kyi las sgrib dag nas thar pa'i lam sna zin par 'gyur ro// dkor mdzod du sbas na longs spyod 'phel bar 'gyur ro// nor lhas su sbas na god yams mi 'byung zhing rta nor 'phel bar 'gyur ro// zhing la sbas na lo tog legs par 'gyur ro// mtsho'am chu mig gi 'gor sbas na char chen po 'bab pa 'gyur ro// me la bsreg na dud pa phog tshad kyi skye 'gro thams cad sangs rgyas pa dang*/ sde brgyad kyi gdug rtsub thams cad zhi ba dang*/ 'go ba'i nad rims rgyun chad par 'gyur ro// lus la 'chang na 'go nad dang mtshon cha'i rigs thams cad thub par 'gyur ro// ril bu chur sbyangs nas zhing la 'thor na 'bu srin dang btsa' sad sogs gnod pa thams cad thub par 'gyur ro// sku gsung thugs rten gyi nang du 'jug na phyag skor 'brel tshad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la phyin par 'gyur ro// khyad par du sa gnad gso ba'i nang gzhug byas na mtha' yi dmag tshogs bzlog par 'gyur ro// gang du bsgrub pa'i yul der bkra shis shing byin chags pa dang*/

'ja' 'od dang sprin rgyun ldan du 'byung ba dang char chu dus su 'bebs par 'gyur ro// than pa dang lo nad btsa' sad thams cad mi 'byung zhing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang mu ge'i bskal pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// mi nad dang phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad par 'gyur ro// phyi nang gi dus 'khrugs thams cad zhi ba dang mtha' yi dmag dpung thams cad bzlog par 'gyur ro// dbang thob pa'i phan yon ni/ dkyil 'khor mthong zhing dbang bskur thob// phung po bdag nyid smin par 'gyur// sdig pa thams cad rnam par spang*// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gnas thob bo// zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ gter ston rat+na gling pa nyid lung bstan zhal gdams dang bcas pa'i mjug nas/ skal ldan de yi gdul bya rjes 'jug rnams: /slob ma bas kyang yang slob rjes slob dus: rim pa bzhin du bstan pa mtha' rgyas 'gyur: mtha' dbus phyogs mtshams kun tu chos 'di dar: snyigs ma'i 'gro ba phyam gcig thar lam bgrod: 'phrad chog mthong grol 'gyur te ngo mtshar che: bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma: las can skyes bu rnams kyis 'di spyod cig: ces dang*/ lang gros zhus pa'i lan las kyang*/ bu bas kyang yang slob kyi dus na bstan pa mtha' rgyas su 'gro bar 'gyur ro: zhes lung bstan pa dang*/ rat+na'i gter chos kyi nang nas kyang thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa 'di bod yul du yun ring dar te thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dang sras byang chub sems dpa'i rigs de dag gi slob brgyud la sogs rim pa bzhin du rgyun ma chad par byon nas yig bdun gyi bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ la las skyong ba dang*/ la las srung bar byed/ rang gzhan kyi don rgya chen por byed pa lung bstan pa ni/ thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud chen po nyid las/ ma 'ongs bstan pa'i sgron me 'di: shāka thub mya ngan 'das nas kyang:

lo ni sum stong nye ba na: rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs ngos: ri bo nag po bcu gsum 'das: kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su: 'gro kun thugs rje chen po'i zhing : thugs rje'i sprul sras brgyud 'dzin gyis: yig bdun bstan pa 'dzin skyong srungs: rim pa bzhin du don gnyis spyod: rgyud mchog 'di yang der snang 'gyur: zhes bka' stsal to// de ltar skal ldan gyi slob ma khyed rnams kyis dad gsum rnam par dag pa'i mos pa brtan po'i sgo nas thugs kyi dpal be'ur sim pa zhu/ zhes chags med rin po che'i gsung las mdor bsdus te si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha wa tu/// / ༈ tshe sgrub thabs shes kha sbyor dbang gi mtshams sbyor skal bzang rna ba'i bdud rtsi zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo ā yuḥ.a mi ta bha pad+mā kā ra ye/ 'dir gter chen mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gter byon tshe sgrub thabs shes kha sbyor gyi smin dbang zab mo'i mtshams sbyor dang dbang bshad dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i phyir du spro na/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bsrang nas bka' srung rnams kyi gtor 'bul grub mtshams sgo dbye 'don/ bla ma rig 'dzin gyis dbang len/ rak+ṣaḥ bar/ de nas slob ma sgo drung du 'dug bcug nas bdud bzhi rnams kyang bton la rim bzhin phyi rol rgyang ring por skyel/ srung 'khor bsgom/ bka' srung gtor 'bul rnams phul grub nas/ hūm̐/ ye shes lnga yi sogs kyis khrus byas nas nang du 'ong la bgegs bskrad/ de nas dkyil 'khor yol ba'i phyi rol du gnas pa la slob dpon gyis dri ba/ kyai hoḥ rigs kyi bu sogs nas/ drang por smos: bar dang*/ de nas slob ma rnams kyis sam yang na rjes zlos kyis/ kyai hoḥ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ kyai legs so sogs dang*/ yang rjes zlos sam slob mas/ lha tshe lha rig 'dzin

sogs zhu/ yang slob dpon gyis/ legs so skyes bu sogs dang rjes zlos sam/ slob mas/ legs so legs sogs zhu nas phyag 'tshal/ yol ba bsal nas drung du 'khod/ slob dpon gyis/ sngon chad dkyil 'khor gnyan po ma mthong pa'i brdar gdong g.yogs 'ching ba'i mos pa mdzod/ mig dar bcings la/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i don tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal ni/ hoḥ bdag lus phung khams sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal phul la/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad du/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa 'od snang mtha' yas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya snyam pas thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas legs par gsan 'tshal/ de yang dus gsum gyi rgyal ba kun gyi bdag nyid shākya'i dbang po'i rgyal tshab dam par bsngags pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan gyi slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang chen po gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid kyis gdul bya mtha' dag smin grol thar lam la bkod pa'i phyir du zab mo'i gdams pa ches cher du mar stsal ba'i nang tshan las/ 'chi ba med pa'i rdo rje'i tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i nye lam zab mo'i gter kha ma 'ongs phyi ma'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba'i slad du gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir tshe ril dang*/ tshe chu lhag par zab mo'i gdams pa 'ga' zhig sbas shing*/ gnas khyad par can bsam yas mchims phu/ g.ya' ma lung*/ 'bras mo ljongs/ pad+ma bkod/ zam bu lung la sogs pa rnams tshe yi sgrub gnas rnams su byin gyis brlabs/ tshe mi 'gyur ba'i rgya yis mtshan pa'i brag phug mā ra ti ka /yar lung shel brag /sgrags kyi yang rdzong*/ lho brag mkhar chu/ khams kyi seng ge gnam mchongs/ skyid 'byams kyi nyi zla phug dang thabs shes phug la sogs pa yang tshe bsgrub pa'i rang byung gi sgrub phug mang por byin gyis brlabs/

ri bo lhun chags pa dpal gyi tsā ri tra/ gtsang gi jo mo kha rag /yar lha sham po sogs dang*/ khyad par ti se gangs kyi ri dang*/ kam po gangs kyi ra ba/ rong btsan kha ba dkar po sogs bod kyi 'brog chen dang*/ gangs ri thams cad kyang rdo rje tshe yi sgrub pa'i gnas mchog tu byin gyis brlabs/ ma pham g.yu mtsho/ gnam mtsho phyug mo/ tsā ri g.yu mtsho/ rma kung lung sogs gtan 'khyil gyi mtsho rnams dang*/ chu mig mang po tshe chu gter gnas su byin gyis brlabs pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas gter du sbas pa las/ da lam skabs su babs pa'i tshe'i sgrub pa'i sgo nas smin grol gyi gdams pa zab mo 'di ni sngon gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*/ ḍā ki lha lcam man+da ra ba rnam gnyis brag phug mā ra ti kar tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i tshe mgon po tshe dpag med dngos su byon te byin gyis brlabs nas tshe sgrub kyi skor du ma gsungs shing*/ o rgyan yab yum dang gnyis med gcig tu 'dres/ skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku thob nas slar gu ru nyid gdong dmar bod kyi yul du 'byon pa'i skabs mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dbu rtser gtan la phab nas bkod cing*/ phyis lha sras mu khri btsan por sngon 'phral smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar nas gter du sbas shing*/ de nyid kyi skye ba'i rnam 'phrul pa rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje drag po nus ldan rtsal zhes grags pa sprul pa'i gter chen gang der sngon sbyangs skyes stobs kyi yon tan smin pa'i mthu las rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba de nyid kyis o rgyan rin po che'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub gnas chen po khams kyi seng ge gnam mchongs brag dang 'brel ba'i snying thang skyid 'byams nyi zla phug gi g.yon zur/

sra brtan rang byung rdo rje'i brag gi dbus nas dngos su skal ldan kun gyis mthong bar gter sgrom spyan drangs nas mkha' 'gro'i brda'i yi ge bkrol nas ji lta bar gtan la phab nas zab chos rin po che gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa dper na rgyu skar stong gi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal la dwangs ba bzhin tshe sgrub thabs shes kha sbyor du grags pa 'di nyid byin rlabs kyi tshan kha rmad du byung ba ste/ de dag gi dkyil 'khor gnyen po'i sgo nas smin byed kyi dbang bskur bsgrub pa la zhing khams kyi lo rgyus gter gzhung rdo rje'i tshig nas gsungs pa ltar brjod par bya ste/ de yang tha tshig lo rgyus mdor tsam bstan pa ni:

sogs nas/ zhal gdams ma nor ba nyid mthar phyin pa'oḥ ces pa'i bar brjod la/ de ltar skal ldan khyed rnams kyis dad pa mos gus dag pa'i snang bas spro ba bskyed par mdzod la/ gsang ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor gnyen po 'jug pa'i blos thog mar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i drung du skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum dang sogs/ lan gsum/ ma gyur dus gsum sogs/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi tshe rabs 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan sngar gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo ye nas las dbang sogs/ de ltar nongs bshags tshangs par bstsal nas las dang nyon mongs kyi sgrib pa'i mun pa rnams bsal/ shes rab ye shes gsal ba'i spyan dang ldan par mos shig / gser gyi thur ma thogs la/ hoḥskyes bu khyed rnams sogs kyis mig dar bsal la lha ngo bstan pa ni/ ho gsan du gsol lo sogs/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la reg pa'i mos pas/ 'o rigs kyi bu rnams sogs nas/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa'o// bar brjod la/ de nas mdun bskyed ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ba rnams dang*/ slob dpon tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul nas khyad par du tshe 'od snang ba dpag tu med pa ye shes sems dpa'i lha tshogs rnams sku che chung sna tshogs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas de dag rnams kyi ye shes chen po'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phrin las kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod cig / de nas rol chas rnams ldir la mda' dar g.yab/ spos 'grim la/ hūm̐/ zhing khams rnam dag sogs kyis slob ma la byin 'bebs dang*/

rang nyid kyang thabs shes kyi dkyil 'khor gsal btab/ hūm̐/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs kyis spyan 'dren/ sa ma ya dzaḥ dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bar brjod la/ spros med kyi mchod bstod dmigs pa bya/ de nas dbang gi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ hrīḥ 'dir tshogs skal ldan sogs nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+raḥ zhes rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la ye shes pa rnams dbyer med du bstim par bya'o// de ltar rdo rje spyi bor bzhag pas ye shes pa de nyid byang chub ma thob bar du 'du 'bral med pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams dang*/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i bum pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i lha tshogs rnams te thabs shes kha sbyor gyi dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyi sku yi cha las ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bum nang nas khol zhing khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus sems bde ba chen pos khyab par sgoms shig /hūm̐/ pad+ma rā ga'i bum dkyil dbus: zhes sogs dbang bskur yongs rdzogs bton nas/ de dag rnams kyis rgyal ba sras dang btsun mo yab yum nyan rang byang sems rigs lnga dang yum lnga/ sems dpa' dang sems ma thub pa rigs drug /lha mo bcu drug /sgo srung khro bo yab yum rnams kyi smin byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi dbang mchog dam pa thob pa yin no// de nas lha dbang lus la bskur ba'i don du 'di'i rjes zlos/ kye/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs/ slob dpon gyis/ kyai/ yi dam lha yi bskyed rim la: sogs nas/ rigs kyi bu: bar brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las mar me gcig la gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon nas khyed rang rnams la thim pas rnam dag rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa gcig char du dbyer med par rtogs pa'i 'dun pa mdzod cig /hūm̐/ rgyal ba rab 'byams gcig bsdus pa'i:

sogs sku gzugs dbang rnams yongs rdzogs bskur nas/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe dang ye shes kyi 'od dpag tu med pa yab yum sras dang btsun mo nyan rang rnams dang*/ rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum sogs kyi dbang bskur bas phung po lnga dang khams lnga rnam par dag ste sku lnga ye shes lnga mngon du gyur pa'i go 'phang thob/ nye sras sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang bskur bas tshogs brgyad kyi 'ching ba rang sar grol/ sprul sku thub pa drug gi dbang bskur bas rigs drug gi rnam smin dag nas skye ba'i sgo chod/ lha mo bcu drug gi dbang bskur bas yul dang yul can gyi snang ba thams cad rnam par dag ste gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sgrib pa rang sar dag /sgo srung khro bo khro mo'i dbang bskur bas bdud bzhi'i bar chad rtsad nas gcod cing las bzhi grub pa chen po brgyad kyi dngos grub dang*/ khyad par du 'chi med tshe'i go 'phang bde blag tu thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so// de nas lhung bzed dang*// 'khar gsil chos gos gtad la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs kyis: sogs dang*/ de ltar kun rdzob mtshan ma rdzas kyi dbang bskur ba'i rten 'brel las don dam par sprul pa'i sku'i rol pas 'gro ba rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bkod pa'i smon lam 'brel pa 'di dgos pa khyad par du 'phags pa'o// khro chas rnams thogs la/ hūm̐/ dpal gyi dur khrod chas sogs/ de ltar dur khrod dpa' chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i dbang bskur ba'i mthus bdud bzhi dang nyon mongs ma lus rtsad nas 'joms shing tshe 'di nyid la dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang thob pa'i rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'o// 'dod yon lnga thogs la/ hūm̐/ mdzes shing yid 'ong sogs/ de ltar tshe rabs thams cad du 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams la rtag par longs spyod cing mi zad pa'i nam mkha' mdzod la dbang 'byor ba'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mchog tu gyur pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i dgos pa'o//

de nas spyi 'gre ltar na tshe 'gugs la 'jug /de min skabs 'dir sbyin sreg las mtha' dang*/ pusti'i lung sbyin gnyis dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i chos skyong bka' gtad bcas chos brgyud spel nges kyi slob ma ma gtogs gar thod thod du mi bya/ spro na/ ling ga la tshe bdud 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum dang sogs bden stobs kyis bkug / hūm̐/ rdo rje tshe dpag sogs kyis phur pas bsgral/ liṅga mer bsreg zhal bstab 'don/ las mtha' slob mar sbyin/ de nas phyi ltar na gsung rab kyi glegs bam a yig dkar pos mtshan pa/ nang ltar na rgyal ba rab 'byams rnams kyi gsang sngags dam pa'i chos kyi rang sgra sgrogs pa 'di'i dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i nus pa mthar phyin nas 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che myur ba nyid du spyod nus pa la dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gsungs sogs dang*/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la gsol ba btab pas gtso 'khor rnams dang khyad par tshe bdag rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum rnams kyis rang 'dra'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur spros nas khyed rang rnams kyi tshe yar ba dang chad pa dang 'thor ba rnams dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi/ khams gsum srid bcud dpal 'byor gyi dwangs ma/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi gsang gsum mi bzad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dngos grub thams cad tshe bdag tshe 'gugs chen po yab yum bcu'i phyag gi bum par bsdus nas khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la dbyer med du bstim nas tshe mi nub pa rgyal mtshan lta bu/ mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung lta bu/ mi shigs pa rdo rje lta bur rtag brtan gzhom bral chen por rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ kyai/ nyi ma shar phyogs rdo rje'i rigs: sogs/ dbyangs snyan pos brjod cing mda' dar g.yab nas mgor bzhag / rdo rje 'chang dbang myur 'grub shog:

bar brjod nas/ de ltar ye shes lnga yi ngo bos dug lnga'i zer bcom ste 'gugs pa dang*/ lha mo lnga yi ngo bos khams lnga'i bcud bsdus te tshe 'gugs pa dang*/ dbyings rig rdo rje dbyings phyug ma dang rdo rje 'chang gnyis ngo bor 'dres te khyed rang rnams kyi sems kun tu bzang po skye 'chi dang bral ba'i klong du skye med du thag bcad/ 'chi med du gdeng bca'/ re dogs la bden med/ snang ba'i yul dang byed las kun rdzob sgyu ma smig rgyu lta bur mdor na dngos snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad dag pa ye shes kyi ngang du rol pa mdzod cig /de nas dpal gyi gtor ma 'di nyid rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs rnams kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas te/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pas dbang bzhi thob/ rgyud bzhi smin/ sku bzhi 'grub/ lam bzhi 'byong*/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe thob/ rgud pa med pa'i lang tsho rgyas/ rtag brtan gzhom gzhig dang bral ba'i mgon po tshe dpag med dang dbyer med pa gtor ma lhar gsal ba mtsho la char bab pa ltar khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /hūm̐/ dpal gyi gtor ma ri rab 'bar: sogs brjod nas/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag /'dir gzhung las ma gsal kyang tshe ril chang sbyin pa ni/ bkra shis tshe yi rang bzhin can// rtsi bcud snying po'i ril bu 'di// tshe dpal 'gyur ba med pa'i rdzas// dngos grub dam pa 'dir rol cig /bkra shis tshe mchog rgya mtsho che// 'chi med lha yi bdud rtsi dngos// tshe ring dpal gyi gter chen po'i// dngos grub dam pa rtag rol cig / ces brjod la bar skabs tshe gzungs rnams bzlas so// skabs 'dir spro na chos skyong bka' gtad gzhung ltar bya/ de nas dbang gi mtha' rten ni/ deng phyin chad khyed rnams kyis theg chen byang chub spyod pa'i sems dang ma bral bar gyis la rigs kun gyi khyab bdag dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang spyi bor bsgom nas tshad med snying rje chen po'i go cha bgos te sems can thams cad byang chub kyi sa la 'god nus pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/

hūm̐/ rang las gzhan gces bsam pa yis: sogs sku spyi bor bzhag / de nas byang chub snying po'i bar du bla ma bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med dbyer med par spyi bor bsgom la lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin nas dam tshig srung sdom rnams tshul bzhin du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ bdag lus phung khams sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ lus longs spyod gtang rag gis yon du 'bul ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de ltar sprul pa'i gter chen rig pa 'dzin pa yongs kyi gtso mchog mi 'gyur rdo rje drag po nus ldan rtsal gyi gter byon zab chos tshe sgrub khyad par du 'phags pa thabs shes kha sbyor zhes bya ba zab gnad bka' rgya can gyi dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i dbang bskur zab mo legs par grub pas de la brten nas rang dang gzhan phan rnam par dkar ba'i las la sbyor ba'i don la yang dag par spyod par mdzod cig / slob ma rnams grol/ sku gsum bla ma dang*/ rten dang gtor ma'i sogs/ bkra shis dang smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// ces pa pun+ya ma ṇi zhes pas 'di ltar yongs la phan pa'i phyir du lhag bsam bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'byung gi dus dang sbyor bar dge ba spel ba maṅga laṃ/ dza yan+tu/ dge'o/// / ༈ nam snying tshe sgrub dbang gi mtshams sbyor bzhugs/ na mo badz+ra a mi tā yu ṣe/ 'chi med rig 'dzin thugs kyi bcud// yang zab tshe sgrub a ti'i lugs// byin rlabs bcud dril smin dbang gi /mtshams sbyor bdud rtsi'i gru char spro// de yang dang po rtsa gsum gyi zhal thang bshams shing mdun du stegs kyi khar maṇ+ḍal la rdul tshon gzhung mthun nam/ tshom bu gang rung gi steng du mañdzi'i khar dpal gtor rgyan ldan gyi rtser/ sku rten tsakli yod na btsugs/ mdun du sman raka gtor gsum/

mchod pa phreng tshar/ las bum gang bder/ tshe ril chang yang bkod/ sngon 'gro dkar bgegs/ spos thun ḍā dril sogs 'du byas la/ las byang bsnyen pa yan grangs gsog dgos min dbang bskur grangs sam/ long skabs dang bstun la bdag 'jug dbang len/ hrīḥ rang gi rang rig sogs kyis gtor ma spyi bor bzhag /tshe ril chang dngos grub tu rol/ las bum rta mgrin bskyed bzlas kyang bya/ de nas slob ma rnams 'tshogs la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus dang sngon gtor bran/ dkar bgegs pad+ma badz+ra ltar btang*/ gu gul bdug /yungs kar brab/ srung 'khor/ hrīḥ snang srid lha yi sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal bkye bsdu bya/ 'o na nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du tshe dbang zab mo zhu snyam pa byang chub kyi thugs bskyed gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po las grub pa'i mi lus rin po che khams drug ldan pa 'di'ang*/ srog gcod pa'i dbang gis tshe thung ba dang*/ rdeg brdung brngan chen byas pas nad mang zhing*/ khyad par sum cu kha ral gyi dus su glo bur gyi 'chi rkyen bsam gyis mi khyab pa de dag kyang las sngon song gi 'bras bu bslu med smin par nges pas/ mo bon rtsis sogs kun rdzob kyi srung skyob spyi dang*/ khyad par srog gcod kyi mchod sbyin sogs sdig dang 'dres pa'i dge bas 'phral phug gnyis kar rnam smin log par 'gyur bas/ rgyu srog gcod spangs shing mi 'jig pa srog gi sbyin pa sogs chos dang zang zing gi gtong ba la goms pas tshe bsring ba mdo sngags thun mong gi lugs dang*/ rkyen rtsa gsum lha yi byin rlabs la brten te tshe bsring ba ni sngags lugs khyad par ba ste thabs zab cing rgya che la 'phral phug gnyis kar rtag brtan bde ba'i dpal yon gong 'phel du 'gyur bas/

de lta bu'i rgyud dang man ngag sgrub thabs kyi rim pa gsar rnying bka' gter gdams ngag mtha' yas pa zhig bzhugs pa las/ da lam gyi skabs 'dir gsang sngags rnying ma ba gter gyi phyogs su gtogs pa mgon po tshe dpag med rdo rje slob dpon gyi rnam par rol pa nam mkha' ji srid skye 'chi 'das grongs mi mnga' bar 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen pos 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa dus gsum kun mkhyen pad+ma saṃ bha ba de nyid kyis rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi thugs bzhed bskang phyir bod yul du bstan pa'i sgron me spar ba mdzad pa'i skabs/ tshe gcig gis grub pa rnam gnyis mngon du brnyes pa'i lo tsā ba brgya rtsa brgyad kyi nang nas/ las can dag pa'i 'khor dgu'i ya gyal/ yang dag thugs kyi rig 'dzin gnub ban nam mkha'i snying pos phyi rabs kyi don du g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pas o rgyan rin po che ra sa 'phrul snang du rab gnas la phebs pa'i shul du/ ye shes sems dpa' sku tshab gzugs brnyan gyi rnam par byin gyis brlabs pa de'i zhal nas ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshe sgrub rdo rje'i tshig rkang rnams gnubs ban chen pos thugs nyams su bstar bas dgung lo nyis brgya lhag tsam bzhugs shing*/ phyis sdig spyod rgyal po glang dar gyis bstan pa la 'tshe ba brtsams pa'i skabs su/ dri chu bhan+dha gang la brten te bskyed bzlas mdzad pa tsam gyis tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor mdun du lhags/ 'od zer dri chu la phog pas khro chu khol ma dang thog ser du gyur nas rgyal po 'jigs shing spa bkong*/ sdig blon rnams kyang brgyal/ hūm̐ sgra bsgrags pas pha rol gzhan sems pham pa sogs dngos grub nus mthu gcig car du thob pa'i zab chos de lta bu ma 'ongs da lta'i skal ldan las can rnams kyi don du/ khams kyi gnas chen nyer lnga'i nang tshan skyid 'byams sgrub gnas seng ge gnam mchongs kyi nye char nyi zla phug gi mdun zur 'gyur med rdo rje'i brag la rgyas btab pa/

chos rgyal mu khri btsan po'i skye mtha' sprul pa'i rig 'dzin chen po mi 'gyur rdo rje drag po nus ldan rtsal gyis las can du ma 'tshogs pa'i dbus su zla ba bdun du 'bad rtsol chen pos rdo rje'i rgya bkrol ba'i tshul mdzad pas mtshon yid ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung zhing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha lhag par che bar rdo rje'i gsung las/ chos rnams kun gyi don bsdus: slob dpon pad+ma'i thugs bcud: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag: nam mkha'i snying po'i chos skal: tshe sgrub 'chi med btsan rdzong: gsang sgrub rdo rje pha lam: zhes bya ba'i dbang bskur gyi rim pa sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams sngon du song nas/ khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/

de nas maṇ+ḍal phul du gzhug / de nas khyed rang rnams rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir bla ma dang rtsa gsum tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor dbyer med pa'i spyan sngar/ mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad gtan bde'i go 'phang la 'god par bya ba'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hrīḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sogs lan gsum/ des dbang don gyi ye shes skye ba'i snod rung du bsgrubs nas/ da byin 'bebs cing ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni/ hrīḥ snang srid lha yi dkyil 'khor sogs/ de nas byin rlabs kyi gzhi 'god pa la/ yul snang sems gsum gdod nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha'i 'khor lor rdzogs pa de nyid brda sprad pa'i tshig brjod pa na/ yin pa la yin par gsal thob mdzod/ las bum chus bran nas/ hrīḥ he ru ka yi cho 'phrul lasaḥ sogs nas sngags dang bcas ḍā dril spos rol bya/ de nas tshe lha ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan 'dren pa ni/ hrīḥ bde ba can dang sogs mthar hūm̐ ngar dang ldan pa'i sgras 'bod cing spos rol bya/ de ltar phab pa'i ye shes sems dpa' brtan par gyur bar mos mdzod/ hrīḥ 'dir byon tshe yi lha tshogs rnamasaḥ sogs dang*/ de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bde gshegs tshe yi pho brang gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba sku rten dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang*/ 'ja' zer thig le lu gu rgyud mu mtha' bral ba'i klong na/ ka dag rang rig rang gsal gyi rang mdangs 'od mi 'gyur ba tshe dpag med dam ye dbyer med thabs shes kha sbyor gyi tshom bu/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas phung khams skye mched dug lnga bdag 'dzin dang bcas pa rang sar dag /gzhi rdzogs klong yangs chen por 'chi med rdo rje dwangs ma'i srog tu smin cing grol/

gnas skabs su tshe bsod ye shes 'byor pa dbang thang rlung rta nyams shing gud pa sor chud/ brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa bla srog gi gter bsdus/ 'chi med mgon po'i rdo rje bzhi dang dbyer med du gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe yi dpal gtor gyis dbang bskur te/ hrīḥ rang gi rang rig gsal ba yiḥ sogs sngags dang bcas brjod cing tshe ril chang yang sbyin/ grangs gsog skabs/ yang gtor ma 'chi med rdo rje tshe'i lha tshogs su gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs khyed rang rnams kyi gnas bzhir thim pas dbyer med du gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥ rang gi rang rig gsal ba sogs sngar ltar gyi grangs 'dzin nas/ mthar/ de ltar yang zab a ti yo ga'i lugs kyi tshe dbang zab mo legs par grub pas/ gnas skabs su 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug /khyad par du dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba bzlog cing*/ mthar thug bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med dbyings dang ye shes su dbyer med du 'gyur la/ skabs su babs pa'i dam tshig srog gcod pa dang*/ 'dod pas log spyod gdug can ar la gtad pa sogs spang bya/ srog bslu nye 'don sāts+tsha btab pa sogs blang bya/ khyad par rang gi sgo gsum ye nas tshe lha'i rang bzhin de yi ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar slob snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bo'i ji ltar sogs/ gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de ltar tshe sgrub yongs kyi zab pa'i mthar thug gu ru rin po che'i thugs bcud 'chi med tshe yi dbang bskur legs par grub pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims sogs brjod/ mthar 'khor gsum spros bral ka dag rdzogs pa chen po'i klong du mnyam par bzhag cing*/ bkra shis dang bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o// de ltar rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i skyes rabs kyi phreng ba bzhi pa mchog sprul gang de'i 'gro don ched du dbon karma bde gsal gyi bzhed ngor si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis bkod pa bstan 'gro yongs la phan dang bde ba'i rgyur gyur cig

/shubhaṃ/ maṅga laṃ/ ༈ 'dir rig 'dzin rta mgrin mgon po'i phyag bzhes su khrus dang maṇ+ḍal/ pad+ma badz+ra ltar gyi dkar bgegs btang*/ rang gzhung bgegs bskrad/ skyabs sems/ slob ma lhar bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol yan grub nas dbang tshig lan gsum brjod pa'i dang pos bum pa/ gnyis pas tshe gtor/ gsum pas sgrub dpe rnams gnas gsum bzhag la dbang bskur/ mthar snying po brjod la tshe ril chang sbyin/ shis brjod rjes kyi bya ba spyi ltar mdzad pa'i phyag srol snang ste zur mang phyogs su brgyud pa sogs kyis 'di kho na ltar mdzad kyin snang ngo*// 'on kyang dkar bgegs ni dkyus tsam la spyi 'gro btang bas 'thus so/// / ༈ pad+ma badz+ra snying thig dbang mo che'i mtshams sbyor gsal bkod rin chen phreng ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pad+ma badz+ra ye/ 'dir pad+ma badz+ra grub thob brgya rtsa'i dkyil 'khor du skal ldan gyi slob ma gzhug par 'dod na 'di'i dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i slob dpon gyis dang po dkyil 'khor bshams bkod/ las byang sogs mthong brgyud bzhin tshul ldan lhag ma bcas grub nas/ ye gsang gi/ bla ma rig 'dzin gyis bdag dbang blangs te/ smin byed dbang gi skabs su babs na slob ma rnams phyag dang bcas mdun du 'khod/ sngon 'gro glud gtor dang dkar gtor mtshams su rol mo ldir la phul/ gu gul bdug /yungs thun brab/ mtshams rngams dang bcas/ hūm̐/ stong gsum kun khyab sogs kyi srung 'khor dang mtshams bcad mthar rol mo bzhag /'di'i bar tshogs pas mnyam 'don/ de nas slob dpon gyis mda' dar me long btags pa rim bzhin thogs la g.yab nas dril gsil dang bcas/ hūm̐/ nga ni thabs kyi he ru ka: sogs nas/ smin grol dngos grub stsolaḥ bar gyi sgo dbye grub nas/ 'o na nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rigs kun khyab bdag gdod ma'i sangs rgyas pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/

de'i ched du thugs gter snying thig dbang mo che gsan dgongs pa'i thugs bskyed gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de'ang gzhi 'byung tshul gyi lo rgyus cung zhig brjod na: sogs/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang nyid gsal dag snyan pas bton la/ de dag ni pad+ma badz+ra gyi yon tan cung zad brjod pa'oḥ bar dang*/ de ltar byung khungs lo rgyus rdo rje'i gsung gis rgyas par bstan pa'i sgrub thabs zab mo 'di yang u rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa yab yum gyis snyigs dus kyi gdul bya rnams la dgongs te lho smar khams phyogs kyi sbas gnas gru gu lha brag tu gter du sbas/ mi 'gyur ba'i rgya bdun gyis rgyas btab gter bdag trak+ṣad nag po la gtad/ gter srung lha brag rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal la bcol/ bden tshig smon lam zab mos mtshams sbyar/ nam zhig gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ ji skad du/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i rol gar las: zhi rgyas dbang drag mngon spyod tshul: ma nges sna tshogs cir yang 'char: da lta'i lha sras 'di nyid kyang: skye ba'i tha ma rgyun chad tshe: sems can rnams la ston par 'gyur: gang zhig zab chos thod pa rtsal: mthong thos dran reg sems can rnams: sangs rgyas thob pa the tshom med: ces gsungs pa ltar rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje drag po nus ldan rtsal gyis rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ngo mtshar mig gi bdud rtsi skal ldan kun gyi spyod yul du mngon sum du snang ba dang bcas spyan drangs pa ste/ rdo rje'i gsung las/ 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i sems can shi gson gang yang rung ste skad cig nyid la 'tshang rgya ba the tshom med do: zhes dang*/ thos pas sems can grol bar 'gyur: bsgom pas 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub: bzlas pas dngos grub rnam gnyis brnyes: dad brtson snying rje'i ngang du bsgrub: ma 'ongs sems can thams cad kun: thar lam bgrod pa'i go cha yin: 'di las lhag pa yod re kan:

de phyir 'di la brtson par gyis: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thos grol gyi dkyil 'khor chen po gter ston rig 'dzin grub dbang chen po nas bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bar du rim par brgyud pa la dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs/ byin rlabs kyi so ma nyams/ gdams ngag gi drod ma yal ba'i dbang bskur zab mo bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams sngon tu song nas/ khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang slob dpon dbyer med pa la/ thog mar gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rigs kun khyab bdag sogs rjes zlos lan gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ legs so skal ldan sogs nas/ skyabs su 'gro bar gyis: bar/ zhes pa'i lan du 'di'i rjes zlos/ legs so: zhes dang*/ de nas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi skyabs su 'gro ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ zhes mtshams sbyar la gur drag rdo rje pha lam ltar/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang byang sems nyan rang lha: bdag dang mtha' yas dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams: skye ba 'di nas sangs rgyas thob kyi bar: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: nang ltar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la: bdag gzhan dus gsum dus med skye 'gro rnams: tshe cig 'ja' lus chos sku'i 'bras thob phyir: dbyer med ngang du snying nas skyabs su mchi: gsang ba ltar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: rang lus rnam dag lha yi pho brang 'dir: gdod ma'i kun bzang ye nas sangs rgyas bzhugs: phung po lnga dag rigs lnga'i rgyal ba gsal: khams lnga dag pa yum lnga bde stong rgyas: rtsa rlung rnam dag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes thig le 'khyil: brjod med rang gsal rang sems kun tu bzang: re dogs blang dor gnyis 'dzin med bzhin du:

gang shar bde sdug chos sku'i rol ba 'phyo: ma bsgrub sangs rgyas sems la skyabs su mchi: so sor lan gsum re/ de nas dbang gzhung bzhin/ rigs kyi bu rnams nas/ sems bskyed mdzod: bar/ de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag gzhan dus gsum dus med skye 'gro rnams: mi dge bcu yi las sgrib dag gyur cing: ma rig 'khor lo kun rtog rnam dag ste: yang dag sangs rgyas sa la rab bkod phyir: gsang sngags drag po'i dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya: 'khor ba dong nas sprug par sems bskyed do: ngan song gnas gsum mi khom gnas brgyad po: ming yang med par zad cing yul 'byin te: rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog: dag pa rnam dag myur du sangs rgyas shog: nang ltar byang chub sems bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bdag dang mtha' yas dus gsum sems can rnams: ye gdod nyid nas rang sems kun tu bzang: phung po lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pa lnga: 'byung ba'i khams lnga ye shes lha mo lngaḥ rgyu rkyen ye nas rang byung lha yi sku: rang gsal rang chas lhun grub gnyug ma'i sems: stong pa'i ye shes 'khor 'das mnyam pa nyid: sgrib g.yogs kun bral ngang du sems bskyed do: gsang ba don gyi sems bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bdag gzhan 'das dang da lta ma 'ongs kyi: sangs rgyas sems can ming du btags pa tsam: sku ni bden med 'ja' lus snang stong gzugs: gsung ni grag stong bden med brag cha ltar: thugs ni dus gsum spros bral lhan skyes thugs: skye 'gags gnas gsum bral ba'i ye shes la: sangs rgyas ma bsgrub rang chas rang gsal klong: ngan song gnas med rig byed 'khrul cha tsam: kun byed rgyal po ye nas sangs rgyas nyid: gang la'ang re dogs kun bral sems bskyed do: zhes dang*/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs shing*/

smin byed zab mo'i snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i skur lam gyis 'di ltar du gsal thob mdzod/ hūm̐ bh+yo: mi rtag chu bur nas/ yig brgyas bskor/ bar/ de nas he ru ka'i yig brgya dpon slob mnyam du gsungs pa'i tshe khrus chab btang*/ de nas dbang gi sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang gi gzhi 'god pa'i phyir ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por 'di ltar du gsal thob mdzod/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na sogs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ snod bcud snang srid mi dmigs sogs brjod cing bskyed rim phog nas/ spyan 'dren rol chas ldir la/ sngon bskal ma sogs/ tshogs pa mnyam gsung gis/ dkyil 'khor gyis khengs par gyur: bar dbyangs rol dang spos 'grim bcas kyis byin dbab/ skabs 'dir gzhung las slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed gsal btab gsungs kyang*/ brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes la slob dpon dang*/ slob mas yid kyi dmigs pas gdod nas ye grub kyi rang bzhin des khyab par gsungs/ de nas slob dpon gdod nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gsal bzhin pa dang*/ mdun bskyed rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+rar gsal ba'i phyag gi bum par gsang sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams bzhugs pa'i dbang khyed rang rnams kyi lus la bskur bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag nas sku rdo rje mngon du gyur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ nga ni pad+ma badz+ra sogs nas bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ bum chu btung*/ smon lam dang rab gnas me tog 'thor/ kā ya su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs brjod/ shog ser pusti'i dbang ni/ de nas rigs 'dus ma hā gu ru'i gsung yi ge'i 'phrul las shar ba'i snying thig glegs bam las gsang sngags yig 'bru'i tshogs char ltar babs nas gsung dbang ngag la bskur bas ngag gi sgrib dag nas gsung rdo rje mngon du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

hūm̐/ nga ni pad+ma badz+ra yab yum sogs kyis mgrin par bzhag la mthar smon lam rab gnas bar/ yang dkyil 'khor rnams las rang byung ye shes kyi sku mar me gcig la gnyis mched kyi tshul du 'phros nas khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ lha dbang sems la bskur bas yid kyi sgrib pa dag nas thugs rdo rje mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas tsakli rnams rim par thogs la snying gar bzhag / hūm̐/ nga ni pad+ma badz+ra yab yum sogs/ lha dbang yongs rdzogs bskur mthar smon lam rab gnas dang bcas/ de nas rigs lnga ye shes lnga dang pha rol phyin drug gi ngo bor rtags kyi phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas sangs rgyas thod pa rtsal dang dbyer med pa'i chos kyi rgyal srid la mnga' brnyes nas phrin las rab 'byams dbang du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin skyes bu

sogs nas/ zhi chas tshang ma'i dbang dang*/ slob ma la mnga' gsol gzhung gsal ltar/ rnga dung rol mo ldir/ dbyangs dang bcas/ drag chas rnams gsol la/ hūm̐/ nga ni khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang: sogs nas/ dbang dang ldan par gyur cig: bar/ de nas phrin las gtor ma'i dbang gi don du/ ye shes las dang 'jig rten gyi chos skyong ba rnams kyi bka' gtad pa ni/ hūm̐: ma hā kā la sogs kyis gtor ma rnams mgor bzhag de ltar gnas skabs su las bzhi'i phrin las sgrub pa dang*/ mthar thug byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad sel ba'i sdong grogs mdzad par mos la/ de nas yang gsang dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs bskur ba ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni pad+ma badz+ra sogs rdo rje 'chang gi sku spyi bor bzhag la/ de ltar dbang bzhi bskur bas sgrib bzhi dag /rgyud bzhi smin/ lam bzhi 'byong*/ sku bzhi'i go 'phang mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar bzlas lung sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐/ rig 'dzin pad+ma sogs kyis glegs bam mgor bzhag la/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng 'phros/ khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba 'khor bar mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso 'khor spyi dril gyi sngags tshan gsum lan gsum bzla'o// de ltar gsung rigs sngags kyi byin rlabs nus rtsal mthu stobs khyed rnams kyi rgyud la 'jug cing brtan par gyur cig /de nas dbang gi mtha' rten rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun byin pas rig pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal thabs la 'khod nas nam mkha' ji srid bar du gzhan don 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ gser gyi 'khor lo sogs rgyal srid kyi dbang lag tu bzhag /dam tshig gi bslab bya sbyin pa ni/ de ltar skal ldan khyed rnams la sogs brjod/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: sogs bkra shis mnyam gsung mthar rol mo ldir zhing me tog gi char bsnyil/

de ltar bcom ldan he ru ka pad+ma badz+ra sangs rgyas thod pa rtsal gyi snying thig dbang mo che legs par grub ba yin pas de dag gi skabs su babs pa'i gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa sngon du brjod bzhin pa rnams ci nus su bsrung snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ dbang bskur rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ slar yang lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas drug cha gcig lha dang bla mar 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de ltar smin byed kyi dbang bskur thob pa'i dge rtsa thams cad mkha' khyab sems can ma gyur rnams kyi don du bsngo bas rgyas gdab par mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma grol/ rten dang gtor ma'i sogs bsdu rim yang byas la bsngo smon mtha' rgyas bya'o// zhes gter gzhung gi dgongs don ji bzhin gzhir bzhag pa'i cung zhig go bde'i ched du mtshams sbyor 'di'ang si tu pad+ma'i ming can gyis bslab gsum rnam dag rag shul dga' ldan chos gling gi bla ma 'jam dbyangs bstan 'phel gyi bzhed ngor bkod pa nongs pa gang mchis kun bzang klong du bzod par gsol zhing*/ dge bas 'gro don 'khor ba dong nas sprug par gyur cig /dza yan+tu/// / ༈ dag snang pak+shi'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs myur 'bebs kyi dbang bshad dang mtshams sbyor bzhugs/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad zung 'jug sku bzhi dang ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas gsan par mdzad 'tshal/ de yang da lam skabs su babs pa'i dbang bskur zab mo las kyang ches zab pa 'di nyid/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gnyis pa de nyid gdul bya spyi dang bye brag gi snang tshul du za hor gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti 'khor tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa thugs rje thabs mkhas kyis 'dul bar dgongs te dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du rang byung skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma'i sdong po la/

dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs rje gcig tu bsdus pa'i gong bu rang byung ngo mtshar sprul sku chen po'i bkod par brdzus te 'khrungs nas gsang sngags bla med rdo rje theg pa mchog gi chos bstan par mdzad cing 'gro ba log pa'i lam la gol pa'i lta ngan wa skyes lta bu'i tshogs kyis gzhan yid bslu zhing brid pa'i tshul 'chos g.yo sgyu can rnams mi 'jigs spobs pa gdong lnga'i nga ros 'gems par dgongs te/ kha ba can gyi dbus ljongs su yang chos rgyal mes dpon rnam pa gsum sogs kyang gu ru nyid dang tha mi dad par sku yi bkod pa tsam las rgyal ba rigs gsum gyi ngo bo'i rnam par rol pa tho ri snyan shal dang*/ srong btsan sgam po'i dus su bod yul gangs ri'i phreng ba 'di nyid du dam chos kyi sgron me sbar ba'i dbu brnyes par mdzad/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis dam pa'i chos kyi srol btod pa'i phyir rgya gar nas lo paṇa skyes mchog ji snyed pa dang*/ khyad par mkhan po bho dhi satwa/ de las kyang khyad par gyi yon tan dpag par dka' ba'i mthar son pa o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs te/ de nyid kyi mtshan dpe'i nyi 'od 'bum phrag tu brdal zhing bod yul gyi log bshes rnams kyi g.yang sa mun pa stug por gyur ba'i drwa ba yang rtsad nas 'byin par mdzad/ dpal mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i bsam yas la sogs gtsug lag khang dang*/ sad mi mi bdun sogs dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ bka' mdo rgyud mtha' dag bod skad du gtan la phab cing rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal ba las kyang gsal ba'i phul du mdzad/ lha srin ma rungs pa rnams kyang rdo rje'i tha tshig gnyen pos dam la bzhag ste rgyal bstan yun gnas kyi btsas su yang shar lho nub byang dbus te sa 'og sa steng thams cad chos dang nor gter gyis bskangs nas ma 'ongs lung zin gyi gang zag so so'i las skal du mi snang ba'i rgya yis btab ste snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus su mdo sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i dpal du byin gyis brlabs te/

de ltar gnas dang gang zag gi srung ma dregs byed rnams la gnyer du gdams par mdzad cing*/ bod yul gyi gdul bya phyi rabs thugs rjes nye bar skyong ba'i slad du lho nub rak+sha srin po'i kha gnon du 'byon par nye ba na/ lha sras mu khri btsan po'i sngon 'phral smon lam btsan pa'i dam bca' zab mo rmad du byung ba'i mthus slob dpon chen pos rjes su 'dzin par gnang ste/ phyi rabs ma 'ongs rjes 'jug gdul bya skal pa las dang ldan pa rnams kyi dpung gnyen dang*/ 'od gsal snying po dri ma med pa'i ring lugs nyams pa med pa'i phyir smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar te sum cu kha ral gyi dus 'dir lha sras mu khri'i skyes rabs sprul pa'i gter chen rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje can zhes grags pa de nyid kyi las skal du sa gter la sogs gter kha du mar dbang ba'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa dang*/ skabs su bab pa 'di nyid dag snang zhal gzigs su mngon par 'char pa de yang*/ rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje'i sogs nas/ ces gsungs pa ltar gyi rje karma pak+shi zhal gzigs mar grags pa/ de ltar gu ru pad+ma dang karma pa dbyer med gnyis su med pa'i tshul sngags rgyud tshad ma rnams su yang spyir nges pa dang*/ bye brag grub chen pak+shis slob dpon pad+ma dang karma pa'i bar brgyud pa yod kyang chog med kyang chog gsungs pa ltar sku dang zhing khams tha mi dad pa chos kyi dbyings su gcig pa'i zhal bzhes thun mong ma yin pa de ltar la/ de dag gi sgo nas lus ngag yid gsum mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po'i blos dkyil 'khor gtso bo dang slob dpon dbyer med pa la gsang sngags zab mo'i dbang bskur yongs su rdzogs par zhu ba'i don du dngos dang yid sprul rgya mtshos drangs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gnang 'tshal/ de nas thog mar dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i don du skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa la slob dpon dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs tha mi dad pa'i drung du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

de nas phyi nang snod bcud snang srid kyi dngos po gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad dag pa rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgoms pa ste snang stong gsal la sgrib med kyi ngang du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ ༈ de ltar ye shes pa de nyid mi 'gyur ba rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod cig /de nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las lnga'i sgo nas dbang mchog dam pa'i smin par byed pa la/ thog mar sku mi 'gyur ba rdo rje gsum dang ro gcig pa'i phyir bum dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ༈ de nas gsung mi 'gag pa tshangs dbyangs yan lag drug cu mi bzad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor dbang thob pa'i mos pa brtan po mdzod cig / ༈ de nas thugs ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi nyi 'od 'bum du brdal ba'i dbang mchog dam pa thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ༈ de nas rang gzhan gyi dpal dang ye shes thams cad dgos 'byung dpag bsam ljon pa bzhin yon tan lhun grub tu 'byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ༈ de nas las dang nyon mongs kyis bslad pa'i sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad las rgyal te phrin las rnam bzhir dbang 'byor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ༈ de nas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang srid zung 'jug spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par zhog cig /de nas gang shar snang ba'i cha thams cad yab dang stong pa'i ngo bo yum gyi rang bzhin gnyis med bde chen gyi ngang du rol par gyis shig / ༈ de nas snang ba thams cad brda chos su ston pa'i dbang ni glo bur yid byed kyi dran rtog thams cad chos sku'i rgyan du ngo shes par sgoms shig / ༈ de nas rig pa'i ngo bo stong pa'i rang rtsal gyi ye shes de yi ngang nas nyon mongs rtog tshogs thams cad rang grol chen po'i dbang thob par sgoms shig / ༈ de nas gtor chen ye shes 'bar ba'i dbang bskur ba ni khyod rang rnams lhar gsal thob la mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas mtsho la char bab pa bzhin thim nas dbang bzhi thob/

sgrib bzhi dag /sku bzhi mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dpal chen grub pa'i dbang phyug karma pak+shi/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ dbang chen dpa' bo rta mgrin/ yum chen dpa' mo rdo rje phag zhal can/ rig 'dzin mi 'gyur rdo rje nus ldan drag po rtsal/ 'khor lo'i mgon po shrī tsit+ta badz+ra bka' babs chos bdag brgyud pa rnams dang/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po rdo rje ber nag po can/ 'dod khams dbang phyug rang byung gi rgyal mo/ dam can skyes bu rdo rje legs pa la sogs pa rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub dam pa myur du stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ bar chad bdud bzhi log 'dren sngon las 'phral rkyen chos min gyi snang ba thams cad rang sar dag par byin gyis rlobs shig /de nas dbang gi mtha' rten rgyas gdab brtan bar gzhom gzhig dang bral ba'i phyir rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ ༈ de ltar rtsa gsum thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bzhi zab mo bka' rgya can 'khrul med nyid du thob pa yin pas phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig mtha' dag rjes su slob pa dang bla med byang chub kyi bar 'du 'bral med par yi dam du kha tsam ma yin par 'dzin snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes zlos/ maṇ+ḍal/ ces dag snang zhal gzigs ma'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'di yang si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos dpal spungs sgrub sder spel ba/ dza yan+tu/// / ༈ dgongs gter gu ru drag po'i dbang gi mtshams sbyor dngos grub dga' char bi ha ra/ rdo rje khro bo ma lus pa// drag po phrin las sna tshogs gzugs// 'dus pa las rab kun gyi gtso// bde ba rtsal gyis rnam kun skyongs// 'dir dgongs gter gu ru drag po'i smin dbang gi sgo nas skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa la/

dang po yo byad nyer mkho'i bshams ni/ stegs bu'i khar dkyil 'khor bsgom don ltar gyi rdul tshon nam ras bris bkod/ bsdu na maṇ+ḍal lte bar lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i 'bru yi tshom bu 'god/ de steng mañdzi'i khar bum pa chas ldan rdzas kyis bkang ba/ de'i khar ka pā la bdud rtsis gtams pa bcas dang*/ g.yas su dpal gtor rgyan ldan sku tsakli dar gdugs dmar po can/ g.yon du rdor dril/ mdun du sku tsakli rnams dang*/ dud khrod dpal chas/ phreng ba dang*/ shel lam me long*/ de'i g.yas g.yon/ rdo rje dang*/ sdigs pa'i gzugs bcas dang*/ sman gtor rak+ta/ gzhan yang mchod pa phreng tshar bshams/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ chad tho/ brtan skyong*/ bka' srung gtor ma sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal/ khrus chab/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bcas mthong brgyud bzhin du 'du bgyis la/ gnyis pa sgrub pa dngos gzhi las byang ltar bdag mdun bum gsum dbyer med bskyed/ bzlas pa dang tshogs mchod phul grub mtshams/ bdag mdun 'od zer spro bsdu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhi yang len par bya'o// gsum pa dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ bgegs gtor btang nas mtshams bcad/ srung 'khor bsgom la dbang bshad spyi 'gro ltar gyi mtshams/ skabs su babs pa dpal che mchog gu ru drag po kī la ya'i sgo nas smin byed kyi dbang bskur zab mo bgyid pa yin te/ de yang o rgyan chen po nyid gdul bya zhi bas mi thul ba rnams drag po'i phrin las kyis 'du la bar dgongs te pad+ma drag po'i skur bzhengs nas mngon spyod snying rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba log par blta ba rnams bsgral zhing*/ bla med byang chub chen po'i gnas su 'dren par mdzad cing*/ de nyid kyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs khyad par du 'phags pa snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i btsas su gdams pa 'ga' zhig gter du sbas pa/ snga 'gyur bka' gter ring lugs 'chang ba sprul pa'i gter chen yongs kyi mnga' bdag nyang ral nyi ma 'od zer dang thugs rgyud ye shes rig pa'i ngo bo chos kyi dbyings su 'dres pa dgongs gter rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas dam pa rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po'i thugs kyi klong las 'char ba'i zab chos 'di nyid nyang dang*/

rat+na'i gter kha las byung ba'i bla ma drag po'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i dbang bzhi'i chu bo gcig tu 'dres pa'i mthu stobs du ma dang ldan pa 'di dag gi sgo nas dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams legs par grub nas/ slob ma'i bya ba dbang bzhi legs par zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ ces maṇ+ḍal phul la/ de nas bla ma dang che mchog pad+ma drag po tha mi dad pa'i drung du dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhu ba'i don du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma bdud 'dul sogs lan gsum/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ bar gyi cha la sangs rgyas byang sems/ pad+ma drag po'i lha tshogs/ yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ 'og gi cha la ye shes chos skyong srung ma rnams gsal ba'i drung du skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs

sogs lan gsum/ sems bskyed 'gro ba sogs lan gsum/ de nas bdun rnam par dag pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sogs lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig / slob ma lhar bskyed pa ni/ chos kun stong nyid spros dang sogs las byang ltar/ spyan 'dren skabs spos dang rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te/ hrīḥ yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling: sogs nas dzab lan gsum mam bdun gyis byin dbab pa'i bar bya'o// de ltar ye shes pa de nyid byang chub snying po'i bar rab tu gnas shing brtan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod la spyi bor rdo rje bzhag /de nas sku gsal stong lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa lha yi ngo bo bum pa'i dbang la brten pa dang*/ gsung grag stong brjod med zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ka pā la bdud rtsi'i dbang dang*/ thugs stong nyid snying rje dbyer med kyi ngo bo rdo rje dril bu'i dbang dang*/ de kho na nyid don dam spros bral ye shes kyi ngo bo rig pa'i rtsal dbang ste bzhi las/ dang po sku bum pa'i dbang ni/ bum pa thogs la/ bum pa skye med kun bzang sogs/ gnyis pa gsung gsang ba'i dbang ni/ thod chang thogs la/ snang ba thabs kyi sogs/ gsum pa thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ rdor dril thogs te/ stong dang snying rjer dbyer med sogs/ bzhi pa rig pa'i rtsal dbang ni/ khyed rnams sems ma bcos par rang babs su glod la 'jog cig / shel lam me long thogs la/ sems nyid ka dag sogs dang*/ de ltar mtshon bya rdzas kyi dbang bskur nas/ mtshon byed tshig gis brda sprad pa ni/ 'khor 'das snang ba'i sogs kyis ngo sprod bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha dbang yongs rdzogs bskur ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon pad+ma drag po dngos yin snyam pa'i 'du shes dang*/

mdun bskyed che mchog pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du rim bzhin lha sku rnams 'phros nas khyed rang rnams pad+ma drag por gsal ba'i lus la sib sib thim par sgoms mdzod cig / thod phreng rtsal yab yum sku spyi bor bzhag / rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs sogs brjod/ de nas gtso bo kī la ya dang*/ khyung*/ 'jam dpal/ rta mgrin/ phyag rdor/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ me dbal/ khro bcu/ ging chen sde bzhi bcas so so'i dbang rdzogs par bskur/ de ltar gu ru drag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi gsang gsum ye shes rol pa'i snang cha dang gnyis med rang byung rig pa'i klong du dbyer mi phyed par gyur pa'i nges shes brtan po mdzod cig /de nas bzlas pa'i lung 'bog pa'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon che mchog dpal du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa zhig 'phros/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ khyed rang rnams drag por gsal ba'i tsi t+ta rin po che zur brgyad pa'i gur khang du pad zla la hūm̐ yig mthing nag gi mtha' skor du zhi ba'i snying po zla ba rgyu skar gyis bskor ba lta bur gsal thob la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig / phreng ba gtad la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ lan gsum/ yang pad nyi la hūm̐ yig gnas 'gyur kha dog dmar po dang*/ de mthar drag sngags 'gal me lta bur 'khor ba gsal thob la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ā ཿhūm̐ artsig sogs/ sngags rnams lan gsum re dang*/ sna tshogs las grub phreng ba sogs/ deng phyin chad 'di nyid rtsa ba'i yi dam du bzung nas bsnyen dang sgrub pa mngon spyod la sogs las bzhi'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don dang*/ bstan pa srung ba'i mel tshe la dbang thob par mos shig / dur khrod dpal chas gtad la/

de nas drag po'i phrin las mtha' dag mnga' dbang 'byor ba'i phyir dur khrod dpal chas bcu yi rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ che mchog dmar nag sogs dang*/ rdo rje dang lcags sdigs gtad la/ de nas khyed rnams khro rgyal yongs kyi dbang phyug che btsan 'gran zla dang bral bar mnga' gsol phyir phyag mtshan gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ lcags kyi sdigs pa nag po mgo dgu pa gtad pa tsam gyis dregs pa sde brgyad zil gyis non dbang du bsdus dam la bzhag /rgyal 'gong dam sri thams cad me dang sbur ma 'phrad pa ltar gzhob thul gyis bsreg pa'i mos pa mdzod/ khro rgyal kun gyi sogs dang*/ gnam lcags sdigs pa sogs brjod/ lag g.yas g.yon du gtad/ de nas mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba ni/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ gtor ma 'di nyid dpal che mchog gu ru drag po pad+ma thod phreng he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dngos su gsal ba de dag gi gsang ba gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs thob/ dug gsum rtogs pa'i dri ma sbyang*/ sku gsum gyi bdag nyid chen po'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur nus pa'i mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub char ltar babs nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa rtse gcig tu mdzod cig /chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo/ mnga' bdag chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ rig 'dzin rdo rje drag po phrin las 'dus pa las rab bde ba rtsal/ bka' babs chos bdag brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ khyad par du dpal ye shes kyi khro bo chen po yongs kyi spyi dpal khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po kī la ya/ yum bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ ye shes khyung chen 'bar ba/

'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje'i gshed po/ rta mchog rgyal po he ru ka dpal/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje gtum po/ gnod sbyin chen po yak+sha me dbal/ rigs bzhi'i ḍā ki sde lnga/ rang byung sprul pa'i khro bo bcu/ bdud 'dul ging chen sde bzhi yab yum la sogs pa gzhan yang ye shes las dang chos kyi srung ma rnams kyis deng 'dir skal ldan 'di rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs bdud ris log par lta ba'i bar chad nyer 'tshe mi mthun ba'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gnas skabs su tshe dpal snyan grags dang 'byor pa rgyas shing mthun rkyen bsam pa thams cad lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ mthar thug sku dang zhing khams tha mi dad par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor dang gnyis med dbyings su gcig pa'i ngang du sangs rgyas par gyur cig /hūm̐/ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad sogs sngags dang bcas brjod/ gtor zan dngos grub kyi tshul du rol nas 'chi med tshe yi srog rtsa brtan pa'i mi shigs par rgyas gdab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor zan dang*/ bdud rtsi bcas sbyin/ de ltar che mchog drag po kī la ya'i dbang bzhi zab mo thob pas gsang ba sngags kyi theg pa phyi nang gsang bas bsdus pa'i dam tshig rnams nyams med bsrung snyam pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ rjes kyi rim pa tshogs la rol/ lhag gtor btang*/ bskul chad tho/ brtan skyong*/ dngos grub len pa/ mchod bstod/ bkra shis sogs gzhung ltar 'grigs chags su bya'o// de ltar dgongs gter bla ma drag po'i smin dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'di bzhin rong mo sprul sku karma rin chen gyi thugs bzhed ltar/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos rab byung bcu bzhi pa gnam lor spyod pa'i khrums stod zla ba'i dbang phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis par yang dben don dam bde dga' gling du spel ba bkra shis par gyur cig

/ ༈ swasti/ gsung rab kyi rigs bklag lung ji bzhin yod med la gdams gtad chags med rin po che sogs kyis byin rlabs 'pho dbang gnang srol la/ kho bos gsar bkod rigs rnams kyang de'i rjes 'brang 'os par/ dang po/ bde gling gter byon tshig bdun gsol 'debs/ byin 'bebs sngags bcas tshar gsum bton la/ ye dhar la su pra tiṣ+ṭha btags pa lan gsum me tog 'thor bzhin brjod/ rgyal kun thugs rje yongs 'dus o rgyan rje'i// gsang gsum byin rlabs deng 'dir 'jug nas su// skal ldan rgyud smin grol ba'i dbang thob cing*// bstan dang 'gro don phyogs med spel ba yi// mthu stobs nus pa mthar phyin lhun grub nas// bla med byang chub go 'phang thob gyur cig / ces dad ldan sngags 'chang maṅga sā ga ra'i ngor spel ba dge/ ༈ byin 'bebs mdor bsdus/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer kyis bskul ba'i mchog gsum rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing du bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ye shes las dang 'jig rten chos srung nor lha gter bdag la sogs pa rang bzhin gyi gnas dang rang rang gi gnas nas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mdun bskyed kyi rten la dbyer med par byin dbab nas/ bdag bskyed skabs rang nyid la sib sib thim par bsgom/ de nas lha so so'i las byang mngon rtogs la 'jug par bya'o// karma bkra shis ngor spel ba dge// /
